descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92592 AC 4; TFA-92585 AC 9; UAT TC-14 ER 2 · “Generate does not run task extraction again (PR #50)”.

Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S12 Generate after Save & Extract runs no second task extraction and leaves the stored tasks exactly as they were (PR #50)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 Generate AI Note does not run task extraction again and never re-marks or removes tasks (PR #50) (TFA-92592 AC 4; TFA-92585 AC 9; UAT TC-14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr; TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both (UAT TC-22 step 4; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Fresh @roundai.test account on the local stack; a Hospital patient and a Nursing Home resident, each with the three UAT tasks typed and one Save & Extract with the UAT bedside text done

When Read the stored tasks (rounding:list / snf:list: A, C), tap Generate Note & Finish and wait for the note, read them again (B, D), while trackActionRequests records every ai/parsing:extractTasks request from the page

Then Zero ai/parsing:extractTasks requests between the Generate tap and the note, in both contexts; B deep-equals A and D deep-equals C (ids, text, done, doneAt): nothing added, closed, reopened or removed

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): T1 (TFA-92592 AC 4, TFA-92585 AC 9). The request count is the discriminating check: an extraction re-run whose result the merge dedups back to the same list still fails it, which a before/after comparison alone would miss. Mirrors the existing spec 'Generate does not send Save & Extract's notes to the extractor again', which covers the medication extractor only, so it is not l …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S12 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-22.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 8b4be94 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-19T17:04:37Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/newspec-c.
